intro: At the Thandol Span, Rhag Garmason waits for word from a missing scout. He sent adventurers to check on Ol' Ebenezer Rustlocke after the dwarf stopped reporting from the great stone crossing. The search beneath its arches may reveal a threat to northern supply lines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush. You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.
Report the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any sign of Ol' Rustlocke, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh my, the news is grave....
